title: WMATA Metrobus bus scorecard, 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-31
subject: wmata

known_issues.note: stamp hand-corrected complete -> partial on 2026-11-26, so the date is excluded: the Muni trip-updates feed was down 10:50-16:32 PDT while the collector stayed up (stored coverage 0.564 passes the coverage test; the outage fails the feed-gap test)

caveats: Different networks. WMATA's GTFS feed is bus-only. SFMTA's feed also carries Muni Metro light rail and cable car. OTP and service delivered pool every route in each feed (so Muni's include rail and cable car); EWT, SWT and bunching are restricted to bus routes (GTFS route_type 3) for both agencies.

One OTP window for both. Both agencies are measured on the same -2/+7 minute window at every observed stop. Neither agency publishes OTP this way (WMATA's scorecard uses timepoints; SFMTA publishes against its own standard), so these figures do not match either agency's official reporting.

Frequent-service scope differs. WMATA's per-route EWT gate uses WMATA's published frequent-route list (15 min for high-frequency and undesignated routes, 20 min for medium-frequency). SFMTA has no equivalent list, so every Muni route uses the 15-minute per-cell-hour gate. System EWT and SWT pool only cell-hours that pass the gate.

Feed semantics differ. Muni real-time data comes through the 511.org regional aggregator, which has a known duplicate stop_sequence artifact affecting per-stop matching; treat Muni figures as approximate rather than exact. Polling cadence and completeness thresholds differ by agency (WMATA Metrobus: trip updates every 30 s, vehicle positions every 60 s, 'complete' at ingest coverage >= 0.800, and neither the trip-update nor the vehicle-position feed silent for more than 90 minutes between 05:00-24:00 Eastern; SFMTA (Muni): trip updates every 120 s, vehicle positions every 180 s, 'complete' at ingest coverage >= 0.533, i.e. 0.80 x the 0.667 ceiling its polling cadence allows, and neither the trip-update nor the vehicle-position feed silent for more than 90 minutes between 05:00-24:00 Pacific).
No ridership weighting. Neither dataset carries passenger counts; system figures weight observations (stops, trips, headways) within a day and days equally across the period, not riders.
Service dates are agency-local (Eastern for WMATA, Pacific for SFMTA).
